title: Tara Warned Vali

claims.claim: Sugriva roared again at the gates of Kishkindha. Vali, in the inner palace, rose in anger.
But one person saw the danger. Vali's queen, Tara.
"The brother who fled in defeat is roaring again so soon. He has not come alone."
"I have heard it from Angada. His friend is Shri Rama: the refuge of the distressed, protector of all who come to him."
"My hero, make Sugriva crown prince. Give up this feud with your brother."
"Rama knows dharma. He is grateful. How could he do a sinful thing?"
Vali swore Tara back by his own life. In tears, she walked around him, chanted prayers for his victory, and went inside.
Then Rama set an arrow like a venomous serpent to his bow, and struck Vali in the chest.
"And Tara's judgement is never wrong. Whatever she says, do it."

caption: Before Vali went out to fight, his queen Tara held him back: Sugriva has not come alone; his ally is Rama; make Sugriva crown prince and end the feud (Valmiki Ramayana 4.15). Vali's answer: "Rama knows dharma; how could he do wrong?" (4.16.5). As he died, Vali told Sugriva: Tara's judgement never fails (4.22.14).

shots.en: Before the duel, Vali was warned. And the warning came from his queen, Tara.
